metrics.definition: Count of AI provider attempts (one per request sent to a model, image, voice or evaluation provider; not user actions) whose start falls in [start, end), with ok / failed / rate-limited / timeout / cancelled / unknown-outcome counts in measures. Retries and fallbacks are separate attempts. cost_basis says how each attempt's cost is known: reported (provider or gateway), price_table (computed from a versioned price table when recorded) or unknown.
metrics.historyGate: Unknown attempts/reservations remain unknown; price version is fixed at use. Forecasts require real mature history.

metrics.definition: Sum of tokens of text attempts in [start, end) by token_type: input (input tokens not served from cache; all input tokens when the provider did not report cached tokens), cached (cached input tokens), output (output excluding reasoning) and reasoning. Provider input counts include cached tokens and output counts include reasoning (OpenAI semantics, PRD 8.0), so the four types partition an attempt's tokens.
metrics.historyGate: Unknown attempts/reservations remain unknown; price version is fixed at use. Forecasts require real mature history.
metrics.limitations: An attempt whose provider did not report a token type counts as coverage unknown for that type (never zero); cached tokens are often unreported on gateway routes. Image and voice attempts are not token attempts.
metrics.nextAction: Verify fresh source→projection→receipt→UI/agent in staging and production.

metrics.definition: Attempts in [start, end) that ran on a fallback route or were a retry (attempt number above 1) divided by all attempts; fallback and retry counts and rates separately in measures.

metrics.definition: Mean recorded cost (micro-USD) of attempts in [start, end) whose cost is known: provider-reported, or computed at write time from the versioned price table named on the attempt; refused attempts cost 0. Attempts with unknown cost are coverage unknown and excluded from the mean.
metrics.historyGate: Unknown attempts/reservations remain unknown; price version is fixed at use. Forecasts require real mature history.

A period without outcomes is not_applicable, never zero.
metrics.historyGate: Unknown attempts/reservations remain unknown; price version is fixed at use. Forecasts require real mature history.
metrics.limitations: A proxy, not a usefulness rating: cost and outcomes are matched by period and workspace, not by task. Learning events expire after 180 days. Unsettled cost rows make the ratio partial.

metrics.definition: Scenario, not a measurement: month-end AI cost for the local calendar month containing the interval end = month-to-date actual ledger cost plus an ordinary least-squares line through the 56 complete local days before as-of, extrapolated over the rest of the month (today counts as the larger of its actual so far and the line; negative days floor at zero). With window: the cumulative cost per day of the month (measures.kind actual or projection). measures name the basis ('scenario'), method, slope and the global monthly budget.
metrics.historyGate: Unknown attempts/reservations remain unknown; price version is fixed at use. Forecasts require real mature history.
metrics.limitations: insufficient_history until 56 complete days of ledger history exist. A straight line ignores launches, pricing changes and seasonality; the budget line is shown only where a global monthly budget exists.
metrics.nextAction: Verify fresh source→projection→receipt→UI/agent in staging and production.

metrics.definition: 5xx responses / all responses recorded by the consumer request hook, per route pattern (method + path with every identifier masked) and period; coverage numerator = 5xx, denominator = requests; 4xx shown as a measure, not as errors. Half-open intervals; window = local day, hour = local hour in the report time zone.
metrics.historyGate: Per-stage watermarks and retained coverage required. API/call global operations counts include internal traffic by current definition.
metrics.limitations: Collected from the first flush after deploy (collectingSince); 30-day retention, older intervals are partial (retention_limited). Best-effort writer: a crash can lose the last minutes of one instance (gap, never zero). No workspace at the route level, so internal, test and founder traffic cannot be excluded. Stale when no row arrived for 20 minutes although the cron requests every minute.
metrics.nextAction: Verify fresh source→projection→receipt→UI/agent in staging and production.

metrics.definition: Per operational counter of the per-minute operational_signals snapshot (delayed, uncertain, failed and held publications; stuck model and research runs; unsettled cost; budget stops; billing rejections; notification backlog and dead letters; growth readings; SMS signals) the peak over the group, with the latest reading and its time as measures. 'counter' is always present; 'queue' groups counters.
metrics.historyGate: Per-stage watermarks and retained coverage required. API/call global operations counts include internal traffic by current definition.
metrics.limitations: Counts of overdue or failed work at each minute, not a per-job wait-time distribution (jobs live in workspace state). Snapshot counts span every workspace. Written by the founder cron each tick; stale when no snapshot arrived for 10 minutes; 30-day retention.
metrics.nextAction: Verify fresh source→projection→receipt→UI/agent in staging and production.

metrics.definition: Connections x capability by provider, capability, health state (ok; expiring within 7 days; expired; blocked = revoked, scopes missing or identity unverified) and capability level, as of the last hourly refresh from workspace channel state using the customer Channels card's own connection_state; measure workspaces = distinct workspaces. Customer workspaces only.
metrics.historyGate: Per-stage watermarks and retained coverage required. API/call global operations counts include internal traffic by current definition.

metrics.definition: Open data requests (status requested) by age band (under 1 day, 1-3, 3-7, 7-14, 14-30, over 30 days) and kind as of now, with the oldest age in seconds as a measure. Every row carries measures.ticketSource = not_collected: no support-ticket source has been chosen (decision D7). Grouping or filtering by 'source' (data_requests, support_tickets) adds the support-ticket source as its own row, unavailable with reason not_collected, never a zero.
metrics.historyGate: Elapsed response/resolution seconds use retained original tickets. Business-time SLA and CSAT have no source; activated support_aging v1 remains privacy-request based until a versioned definition replaces it.
metrics.limitations: Data requests are not a ticket system; support conversations are not collected (D7). A current snapshot; the interval does not filter it.
metrics.nextAction: Verify fresh source→projection→receipt→UI/agent in staging and production.

metrics.definition: M23 definition v1. Cohort: non-excluded workspaces created in the interval whose 14-day window has matured by asOf (immature workspaces are counted in measures.immature, never in a step). Steps, each counted independently within 14 days of creation: workspace_created (cohort anchor), channel_connected, voice_activated, draft_created, draft_approved, post_scheduled, publish_verified. value = workspaces that reached the step; coverage numerator/denominator = reached / matured cohort (or / workspaces the taxonomy observed for steps without a proxy); measures name the source ('taxonomy', 'transition_proxy', 'taxonomy+transition_proxy'), the proxy, rate, dropFromPrevious and stuckFromPrevious (reached the previous step but not this one).
metrics.requiredSource: pr_workspaces.created_at (business_workspace_starts) + pr_product_events §8.6 taxonomy (business_product_events) + transition proxies: pr_audit_events channel.connected (business_channel_audit), pr_learning_events draft.approved/post.published with their daily rollup (business_learning_events, business_learning_rollups), pr_notification_events publish.verified
metrics.historyGate: First-seen taxonomy coverage, mature cohorts and minimum sample required; no invented prior activity.
metrics.limitations: Registration is not success. Transition proxies are lower bounds (learning events are not written while a workspace turns learning off), so proxy-based steps are partial. voice_activated, draft_created and post_scheduled have no proxy: until the taxonomy has observed a whole cohort they report only the workspaces created after it began collecting (collectingSince) and the rest as unknown, never as not reached. Steps are counted independently, not in order: a Quick start draft can come before a channel connection.
metrics.nextAction: Verify fresh source→projection→receipt→UI/agent in staging and production.

metrics.definition: Cohort = non-excluded workspaces created in a local calendar week (Monday start, report time zone) within the interval. Cell (cohort, week k = 0..12) = workspaces of the cohort active (activity definition v1) during local calendar week cohort+k / cohort size, observed through asOf. Only matured cells (the whole week k has ended) carry a value with numerator/denominator; unmatured cells are returned as not_applicable with reason cell_not_matured.
metrics.historyGate: First-seen taxonomy coverage, mature cohorts and minimum sample required; no invented prior activity.
metrics.limitations: insufficient_history until 56 days (8 matured weeks) separate the earliest workspace from asOf. Week 0 is the partial signup week. Automation-run activity counts as activity (active_workspaces v1). No comparison period.
metrics.nextAction: Verify fresh source→projection→receipt→UI/agent in staging and production.

metrics.definition: P2 hypothesis. Population: non-excluded workspaces created in the interval at least 56 days before asOf (and, for a feature without a transition proxy, after its taxonomy began collecting). Adopter = used the feature within 14 days of creation; retained = active (activity definition v1) in days 28-56 (weeks 4-7). value = retained share among adopters; measures carry basis='hypothesis', adopters, nonAdopters, both retained counts, nonAdopterShare and difference.
metrics.requiredSource: pr_workspaces.created_at + pr_product_events + pr_agent_runs + pr_notification_events + pr_learning_events (with rollup)
metrics.historyGate: First-seen taxonomy coverage, mature cohorts and minimum sample required; no invented prior activity.
metrics.limitations: Correlation, not causation: adopters may differ in intent. Groups under 10 workspaces are suppressed. insufficient_history until 8 matured weeks exist overall, and per feature until its taxonomy has collected for 56 days.
metrics.nextAction: Verify fresh source→projection→receipt→UI/agent in staging and production.

metrics.definition: Over [start, end): per customer (workspace, else subscription) and currency, opening MRR at start versus closing MRR at end. new (no MRR at start, never paid before), reactivation (paid before, none at start), expansion, contraction and churn (MRR at start, none at end) are signed net changes; opening and closing rows cover the same customers, so opening + movements = closing exactly. Without the movement dimension the value is the net movement.
metrics.requiredSource: pr_subscription_events (057) via business_subscription_events; daily pr_subscription_snapshots to flag customers paid before their first event
metrics.historyGate: Real signed lifecycle and native currency amounts required; fixtures excluded. Forecasts need the catalog-defined history.
metrics.limitations: insufficient_history until events cover a full month and reach back to the interval start. Net per customer: changes that offset inside the interval cancel out. Customers with unknown MRR at either end are excluded from every row and counted as coverage.unknown. The Demo dataset has no subscription-change history: Demo reports demo_not_simulated.
ownerDependencies: merchant activation and per-action charge/refund confirmation
metrics.nextAction: Verify fresh source→projection→receipt→UI/agent in staging and production.

metrics.definition: Scenario, not a measurement: an ordinary least-squares line through the most recent (up to 90) daily MRR snapshot totals before the interval end, by native currency, extrapolated to each requested day (or the interval's last day); negative values floor at zero. measures.basis is 'scenario' and measures names the method, fit days and slope.
metrics.historyGate: Real signed lifecycle and native currency amounts required; fixtures excluded. Forecasts need the catalog-defined history.
metrics.limitations: insufficient_history until 56 daily snapshot points exist per currency. A straight line is a scenario for discussion, not a prediction; it ignores seasonality, pricing changes and churn shocks.
